user_instruction: after all the tests, scale up the best model with best practices
authorization: Proceed to longer training once the finite checks below are completed; no repeat permission request for that transition.

remaining_tests.next: No additional averaging sweep; preserve original checkpoint and proceed to remaining tests.

Short measured memory-budget comparison at fixed effective batch and identical original examples. Verify complete tokens, finite gradients and consumed-row accounting. Choose throughput per GPU-second, not memory occupancy.
Replicate the shortlisted 17.58M versus 42.48M Muon size comparison with a second seed. The 78.15M arm failed the initial held-out gate; do not designate it best from its public score.

Compare surviving size/recipe candidates at matched measured GPU-time budgets, capped at 10 training minutes per arm, with multiple checkpoints. Confirm the winner with another seed before an expensive run; retain AdamW for mature-checkpoint continuation because Muon transfer failed.

scope_boundary: Finish this finite priority list. Reopen rejected methods only for a concrete new diagnosis. Do not claim all conceivable optimizations are exhausted.

selection.primary: Greedy executed-answer accuracy on held-out original training questions, checked separately on both subsets
selection.caveat: The existing held-out subsets have been reused; results are exploratory. Reserve fresh question groups and exclude them from training before final recipe confirmation. Public leaderboard results are reporting outcomes, not recipe-selection targets.

long_run.model: Best confirmed model and recipe; increase parameter count only if the comparison supports it.
long_run.first_stage: Train through one verified complete pass of eligible original rows, with exact resumable row/token accounting. Define and record any newly reserved validation exclusions before launch.
long_run.coverage: Never infer exposure from steps or shard availability. Preserve traversal cursor on resume and count only optimizer-consumed batches.
long_run.schedule: Set the learning-rate schedule for the intended full-pass budget instead of restarting a short cosine cycle at every checkpoint.
long_run.checkpoints: Persist model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG state, coverage cursor, configuration, hashes and metrics to Drive at bounded intervals; generate 1919 strict-greedy programs in official order, export from Drive, verify hashes, and evaluate every retained checkpoint in the bot.
efficiency: CPU preparation and hash verification before GPU allocation
Measured memory-budgeted batches without truncated questions or targets
Existing mixed precision, clipping, length grouping and prefetching where supported
Record GPU utilization and total elapsed time including setup
long_run.stop: Stop immediately on nonfinite updates, corrupted checkpoints, or coverage failures. Evaluate the full-pass checkpoint before authorizing further passes automatically; do not extend indefinitely on a flat or declining held-out trajectory.
long_run.delivery: Keep the strongest verified checkpoint; update reproducible inference notebook and PDF. Final T4 timing remains a separate required validation.
